title: webhookSubscriptions query returns nothing although webhooks from shopify.app.toml are being delivered
symptoms: webhookSubscriptions returns an empty list for topics that clearly fire
Each order webhook arrives twice after adding the topic to shopify.app.toml
Changes to the toml webhooks have no effect in production
cause: Subscriptions declared in shopify.app.toml are app-wide and config managed, so the Admin API does not list them, and they only change when a new app version is released. Old API-created subscriptions to the same topic keep firing alongside them.
fix: Check toml subscriptions in the Dev Dashboard under the app version, delete the old API-created subscriptions to the same topics before migrating, and run shopify app deploy after each toml change.
affected: Shopify apps using shopify.app.toml webhooks with Shopify CLI 3.x and 4.x
